technical_analysis: We assess nearshore Terraform engineers on their ability to build secure, modular, and automated infrastructure. Candidates are tasked with creating a multi-environment infrastructure on a major cloud provider using Terraform. They must demonstrate a deep understanding of Terraform modules, state management, and remote backends. We require our nearshore Terraform engineers to implement security best practices, including policy-as-code with Sentinel or OPA, and to integrate their Terraform workflow into a CI/CD pipeline. The final result is a secure, scalable, and maintainable infrastructure that can be managed entirely through code. This ensures the nearshore Terraform engineers you hire can build and manage a truly modern infrastructure.
